rows.ARS:
Pink blend Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Violina ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Hans Jürgen Evers (1940-2007) (Germany, 1990).
Introduced in Germany by Rosen-Tantau/Tantau Roses in 1998 as 'Violina'.
rows.Bloom: Light pink, lilac highlights, white reverse. Moderate fragrance. 40 petals. Average diameter 4.75". Very large, full (26-40 petals), cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit: Tall, bushy, few or no prickles/thorns, upright. Large, glossy, dark green foliage.
